scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/tests backend/scripts/*.mjs frontend/src frontend/tests frontend/playwright.config.ts shared scripts/*.mjs scripts/graphics tools/assets/*.mjs tools/transcription/*.mjs tools/transcription/*.json tools/transcription/*.md *.md "docs/**/*.md" *.yaml .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend/src backend/tests backend/scripts/*.mjs frontend/src frontend/tests frontend/playwright.config.ts shared scripts/*.mjs scripts/graphics tools/assets/*.mjs tools/transcription/*.mjs tools/transcription/*.json tools/transcription/*.md *.md "docs/**/*.md" *.yaml .github
